'''Ayuma''' is a sub-continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[Vihsanna Ocean]] and [[Nasianian Sea]] to the south. [[West Ayuma]] to the north and [[Central Ayuma]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|1,610,578|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 22nd largest continent in the world, with a total of about 1,020,200,000 as of 1765, making it also the 11th largest continent by population.
